lib.process.cnc_3axis.doc: 3-axis CNC milling DFM ruleset (spec §7.1). Tribal shop knowledge as statically checkable claims.

min_internal_radius.message: internal pocket radii must clear standard cutter radius + margin so the tool sweeps rather than dwells

no_sharp_internal_corners.message: sharp internal corners are impossible on a rotating cutter

min_wall_thickness.message: thin walls chatter and deflect under cutting load

loaded_corner_fillet.message: loaded internal corners retain fillets as stress relief — a rule that saves machining minutes by seeding a crack is not a rule

min_draft_angle.message: faces along pull direction need draft to release

fillets_everywhere.message: sharp corners concentrate stress and impede flow
